Hi! I'm Ruiyao Zhou — you can call me **Ryan**. I'm a final-year MSci Mathematics with Year Abroad student at Imperial College London. I spent my year abroad at MIT, from August 2025 to May 2026.

I'm interested in the interplay between **analysis, geometry, and partial differential equations**, particularly questions around minimal surfaces. My mathematical interests also include probability.
